title: Conditional pointer-advance labels
statement: For natural-number parameters $a,b,f$, a choice $k$ among $0,1,2,3$ and a natural number $i$, define the label to be the pointer-advance label for choice $k$ when $i=0$; when $i\ne0$, use the corresponding label from the pointer-advance assignment: the second-letter end test with remembered value false for $k=0$, that test with remembered value true for $k=1$, the first-letter end test for $k=2$, and the copy site for $x:=p$ for $k=3$.
